purpose: Calculation reliability only; no outcomes, strategy optimization or episode generation
causalityComparison: Exact equality of decision-time projections at the identical history origin; no tolerance
normalization: Price deltas / longest past-only reference ATR when finite and positive; RSI differences are points, never price/ATR errors
referenceLimitation: Longest available past-only prefix is a reference, not proof of absolute convergence; no acceptance/error budget is optimized
